title: BAMpiro: bacterial short-read mapping, variant calling and lineage/drug-resistance typing
description: A Nextflow (DSL2) pipeline for short-read bacterial and Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex analysis: read QC and contamination screening, length-aware mappability masking, mapping, variant calling, consensus generation, SnpEff annotation, alignment-free lineage and WHO drug-resistance typing with Pathotypr, and a single self-contained interactive QC report.
